#!/bin/bash
# [xihanzu-NR]
# llama.cpp Pterodactyl Installation Script

apt-get update
apt-get install -y curl jq tar libgomp1 ca-certificates

cd /mnt/server
mkdir -p bin lib models

if [ "${LLAMA_VERSION}" = "latest" ] || [ -z "${LLAMA_VERSION}" ]; then
    echo "Fetching latest release tag from GitHub..."
    LLAMA_VERSION=$(curl -sL https://api.github.com/repos/ggerganov/llama.cpp/releases | jq -r '[.[].tag_name | select(startswith("b"))][0]')
fi

echo "Using llama.cpp version: ${LLAMA_VERSION}"
DOWNLOAD_URL="https://github.com/ggerganov/llama.cpp/releases/download/${LLAMA_VERSION}/llama-${LLAMA_VERSION}-bin-ubuntu-x64.tar.gz"

echo "Downloading binary from: ${DOWNLOAD_URL}"
curl -sL "${DOWNLOAD_URL}" -o llama.tar.gz

if [ ! -f llama.tar.gz ] || [ ! -s llama.tar.gz ]; then
    echo "Error: Failed to download llama.tar.gz! Check release tag."
    exit 1
fi

echo "Extracting binaries and libraries..."
tar -xzf llama.tar.gz --strip-components=1
rm -f llama.tar.gz

mv lib*.so* lib/ 2>/dev/null || true
cd lib 2>/dev/null && {
  for f in *.so.*.*.*; do
    [ -e "$f" ] || continue
    base=${f%.*.*}
    major=${f%.*}
    [ -e "$base" ] || ln -sf "$f" "$base"
    [ -e "$major" ] || ln -sf "$f" "$major"
  done
  cd ..
}

for b in llama* ggml*; do
  if [ -f "$b" ] && [ -x "$b" ]; then
    mv "$b" bin/ 2>/dev/null || true
  fi
  chmod +x "bin/$b" 2>/dev/null || true
done

cd bin 2>/dev/null && {
  for l in ../lib/*.so*; do
    ln -sf "$l" "$(basename "$l")" 2>/dev/null || true
  done
  cd ..
}

if [ -n "${MODEL_DOWNLOAD_URL}" ]; then
    echo "Downloading model from: ${MODEL_DOWNLOAD_URL}"
    curl -L --progress-bar -o "models/${MODEL_FILE}" "${MODEL_DOWNLOAD_URL}"
fi

echo "Installation complete! Structure organized into bin/, lib/, and models/"
